  "tokenized_directions": [
    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "Prepare the {{ing_01|hare}}, bone it, garnish."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "Put it in a stew pot and when half done add a small bunch of {{ing_02|leeks}}, {{ing_03|coriander}}, {{ing_04|dill}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "While this is being done, put in the mortar {{ing_05|pepper}}, {{ing_06|lovage}}, {{ing_07|cumin}}, {{ing_08|coriander seed}}, {{ing_09|laser root}}, {{ing_10|dry onion}}, {{ing_11|mint}}, {{ing_12|rue}}, {{ing_13|celery seed}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "Crush, moisten with {{ing_14|broth}}, add {{ing_15|honey}}, the {{ing_16|hare’s own gravy}}, {{ing_17|reduced must}} and {{ing_18|vinegar}} to taste."
    },
    {
      "step": 5,
      "text": "Let it boil, tie with {{ing_19|roux}}, dress, garnish the roast on a platter, underlay the sauce, sprinkle and serve."
    }
  ],
